...All present,@Her Highness Princess Shana-Mia Eterna Fura@graces us with her presence.
Shana-Mia
Thank you all for your service.@After Sentinel Commander E-Selda Shune@departed with the Throne Unit Granteed...
...the <Gate of Voda> has unexpectedly@opened once more, and calamity draws near.
This time, we must vanquish the Vaula ourselves@and seal the Gate. To that end, I have questions@for the head of the Furia Holy Knights.
Knight Commander of the Furia Holy Knights,@Gu-Landon Gortz.
Gu-Landon
I am here.
It seems Knights and <Agent>s are moving@to recover the Granteed...@yet I have received no detailed report. Why?
I intended the recapture of the Throne Unit@to serve as my final report to Your Highness.
I sense tension in the air of Gaw-La.@Yes, just as during the Great War.
To investigate the Gate of Voda and retake@the Throne Unit, we must decoy or check the@Earthlings' forces. Battle is then unavoidable.
What's more, as you say, the Gate has opened.@The Knights have been at combat readiness@for several days now.
That is no reason to break the Knights' taboo.@Unless our very existence is at stake,@its use is forbidden.
...As you wish.
Karo-Ran
(Her Highness sensed it without being told...@Our plan to retake the Throne Unit@using Larseilam.)
Nor must you set the Earthlings' cities ablaze.
However, a situation has arisen@that does not allow for such restraint.
Da-Nia
What happened?
Unidentified objects have appeared in several@of Earth's major cities. The Knights have@designated them Jevilun.
Jevilun... The name of a demon that@devours <Miasma>, is it not?
Precisely, Your Excellency the Chief <Chancellor>.
Could they have come from the Gate of Voda?
We Agents are monitoring the Gate,@but nothing has emerged since that dispersed light.
Then they aren't Vaula...?
They multiply differently from those creatures.@We've also received reports of several@fusing together into giants.
Most likely, they resemble the Vaula@but are something else entirely.
Even so, having appeared after the Gate@of Voda opened, they can hardly be@entirely unrelated.
Therefore, we should send Knights to Earth@to investigate the Jevilun... and determine@whether our blades can slay them.
Very well. Whom will you send?
Al-Van Ranks, step forward.
Sir!
I assign you to investigate the Jevilun.
As you wish.
Al-Van, should you encounter Earth forces@during your mission, do not engage them@without need.
Yes. I humbly receive Your Highness's command.
Japan - Osaka, Umeda District
Steel Dragons
Hagane - Briefing Room
Now, let's sum this up. Before the Sealing@War, a huge ring of light appeared off Choshi...@a gate to another dimension. It soon vanished.
Axel and Alchemie learned of it@and went to investigate on their own.
Meanwhile, Debudedabide sent@<Madnet> to the BF Base in Asakusa,@plotting to seize the Compatible Kaiser.
Kota and Shoko pursued the stolen Kaiser,@and Axel and Alchemie joined them there.@They succeeded in retaking it, but...
Then Madnet latched onto Alchemie's@Person-Lichkeit, and the gate opened again.
And then, to rescue Alchemie as she was@dragged into another dimension, Kota and Axel@charged into the gate, but...
They couldn't escape, and the three of them@were flung into another world called@<Endless Frontier>.
But according to Debudedabide, that wasn't@his intent. Do you believe it, Roa?
Roa
Yeah.
On what grounds?
Because Debudedabide's goal back then was@the same as that of Crystal Dragoon,@whom we encountered the other day.
What do you mean?
I've heard it before, but Axel doesn't know@the details. Roa, explain it to him.
Understood. Axel, as you know, <Dark Brain>'s@goal was to wipe out intelligent life across@many worlds and absorb their negative thoughts.
And as a means to achieve that, he sought@a more advanced dimensional transfer ability.
Right...@That's why Dark Brain tried to get his hands@on the Overgate Engine.
Hence, even while seeking to erase me, his@nemesis, he had no intention of destroying@the Kaiser itself.
And Debudedabide, who followed him here,@very likely had the same goal.
I see. So that's why the Madnet in Asakusa@latched onto the Compati Kaiser...@to take it instead of wreckin' it.
They probably meant to go through the gate@Debudedabide opened and bring him the Kaiser.
But back then, Madnet latched onto@the Person-Lichkeit too.
Debudedabide's gate at that point@was likely incomplete and unstable.
Oh... That Buddha bastard was yappin'@about not bein' in top form or somethin'.
So he likely used the Person-Lichkeit,@with its Einst spatial transfer ability,@as a key to stabilize the gate.
And as a result, the door between dimensions@led somewhere Debudedabide didn't intend...@to Endless Frontier, you mean?
The Madnet that possessed the@Person-Lichkeit may have been controlled or@guided by something other than Debudedabide...
(If it wasn't that Buddha bastard's doing...)
...That is not my fault.
N-Nobody said it was.
(The cause lay on the 'other side'...)
When we tried to return to this world too,@some force seemed to act on us. Because of it,@I was separated from Kota.
Yeah, that's right.
I believe gates leading somewhere other@than here are often unstable.
(True enough...)
According to Dr. Shu Shirakawa, the boundary@between this world and others is blurring@because of the Earth itself, but...
And that <Cross Gate Burst> too?
We can't say anything about that yet.
...Then let's go over the other questions.@First, about when Debudedabide@reached the Earth Sphere.
As I explained, in the final battle before I@came here, the Dark Brain Army's executives@fought the mothership Grandred Fenossa.
If not only Crystal Dragoon but Debudedabide@survived as well... then sadly, the Fenossa@was most likely defeated.
They then followed Dark Brain and likely reached@the Earth Sphere after the <Shura Revolt> ended@and before <The Sealing War> began.
How?
Debudedabide can use spatial transfer, but he@lacks Dark Brain's jumping ability.
He most likely used one of the army's bases,@the huge mobile fortress Dark Iron Castle,@to transfer repeatedly until reaching Earth.
But they didn't make it in time for@our final battle with Dark Brain.
In the battle with Grandred Fenossa,@Crystal Dragoon, Debudedabide, and@the Dark Iron Castle...
...were very likely badly damaged.@So it took them time to reach the Earth Sphere...
Before the Sealing War, he could only open@an unstable gate, and perhaps couldn't even@sortie himself.
So the reason they didn't make any big@moves from then until recently...
Whether they were entirely inactive, I can't say...@but presumably they needed time@to heal and regroup.
So now Debudedabide can open@stable gates?
Even so, advanced dimensional transfers or@ultra-long-range warps are likely impossible.@And judging by his use of Madnet in combat...
...the Dark Iron Castle likely can't yet@function at full capacity, and the Dark Brain@Army's forces aren't fully assembled.
If they were at full strength and after the Kaiser...@they could simply warp their stronghold@straight to Asakusa and be done with it.
Shaddup. Even if they did that,@ya think I'd go down that easy?
...That's where my question lies.
Whoa, you sayin' I'd lose to those guys?
No. It's that their target has changed from@the Compatible Kaiser to the Lamaris. Roa,@do you know anything about that?
Debudedabide's aim earlier was likely@the same as the Steel Dragons'.
Wh-Whaddaya mean?!
You mean he was looking into why@we're able to annihilate the Lamaris?
Yes. I don't know what he plans to do with it,@but if he showed up while still unprepared...@they must regard the Lamaris as important.
You think they intend to make them their own forces?
It's possible.
Then, one more thing.@Where do you think@the Dark Iron Castle is?
During the battle in Sapporo,@the Madnet may have been sent in by means@other than spatial transfer.
Judging from that, it's likely somewhere@in the Earth Sphere, but I can't tell@its exact location.
Ain't there any way to find it?
The Dark Iron Castle has advanced@camouflage. If we got close, the Kaiser's@sensors might be able to detect it, but...
Finding it by any other means@would be extremely difficult.
And if they withdraw via spatial transfer like@Debudedabide just did, we can't track them either.
So all we can do is wait@for those guys to show up...!
For now, yes.
Understood. I'll report this matter upstairs.
Hagane - Commander's Office
Miles
...How much longer until maintenance@on the Hiryu Custom's spatial transfer device is done?
The work is behind schedule,@but it'll be done within two hours.
I see. Then I'll relay our new orders.@At present, we the Steel Dragons are the only@ones to engage and annihilate the Lamaris...
Moreover, we are the only ones@who have encountered the Lamaris Kaana.
The reason has yet to be identified,@but top brass has judged that we have@the ability to annihilate the Lamaris...
...and so, until other units can reliably defeat@them, we'll be deployed from front to front.
Also, to carry out future missions efficiently,@the Hagane will be fitted with a spatial@transfer device provided by the Zovorg.
(Finally...)
The Hagane's main forces will move to the@Hiryu Custom at once. The Hagane will then@head to Izu Base to have the device installed.
Once its maintenance is complete, the Hiryu@Custom will warp to Taipei and annihilate@the Lamaris nesting there.
Friendly units have contained the Lamaris@in the city, and the civilian evacuation@is complete.
Roger.
I'll return to Izu on the Hagane.@Lieutenant Colonel Lefina, I leave command@of the Taipei operation to you.
What about the Drift Wing@and Fairy Klibia?
Per Dr. Wan's report, the Drift Wing will be@moved to the Hiryu Custom to further study its@link to the Lamaris. Fairy Klibia as well.
Then I leave the rest to you, Lieutenant Colonel@Lefina. Following Osaka, show me a fine job@of wiping out Taipei's Lamaris too.
I'll do my utmost, Commander.
Hiryu Custom Hangar
Hey, Lato.@That container they carried off earlier...@it was sealed up tight. What's inside?
...I don't know.
Captain Aya, do you know anything?
No...
(Could it be...@that the Drift Wing is inside there?)
Tenia
Calvina, our hangar assignments are set.@They said to move the units ourselves.
...All right.
Jeez... We just got here and we're already@movin' to the Hiryu. Talk about hectic.
Can't be helped.@The Hagane suddenly has to go back to Izu.
How come?
Beats me... Yuuki, you hear anything?
The Hagane is getting a spatial transfer device.
Huh, really?
Yeah. We'll be going around wiping out Lamaris@everywhere. If both Steel Dragons motherships@can warp, our mobility goes way up.
Then they should put one on the Kurogane too.
Not a chance. It was surprising enough that the@new Steel Dragons summoned me and Carla, who@are officially wanted fugitives.
The new commander's a real hard-nose, right?@I've only seen him from a distance, though.
Still, the reality is that to get results, he@can't afford to fuss over the pasts of people@like us.
Ah, whatever. If we're the only ones who@can beat these Lamaris things, I'll do a@road tour or whatever it takes.
(...Give me a break.@The enemy I need to defeat isn't the Lamaris.)
(Where is he... Where is the gray <Thorn> now...?)
Hiryu Custom - Private Quarters
Jinpu
...So you both came.
What's this important talk about?
You've been spending a lot of time in the@Hagane's rear hangar lately... Is this@about that, by any chance?
(Ugh... She's sharp.)
Oh, did I hit the mark?
Nah, that ain't it. It's about Fairy Firefly,@who you two met at Izu Base the other day.
Oh, that beautiful lady.
Truth is... she's aboard the Hiryu Custom now.
Huh? Why?
Wasn't she hospitalized with amnesia?
She was, but so she can start ASAP as Soul@Saber's dedicated mechanic, she'll continue@treatment in the Hiryu Custom's sickbay.
I meant to tell you two@a lot sooner, but...@y'know, things've been busy lately.
Hmm... Isn't that a pretty important thing to tell us?
Yeah, that's not like you, Jinpu.
My bad.
(Even I know that's a lame excuse...)
...Fine. So, what do you want us to do?
Strictly speakin', it's Akimi I need.
Oh, could it be...@this has to do with someone she knows@looking like me?
Right. When you get the chance, could you talk@with Fairy? It might help her get her@memories back.
Sure. That's no trouble at all.
(...Something's fishy. There's more to this...)
Hiryu Custom Bridge
Sean
Captain, we're ready to sortie.@All personnel are at level-one battle stations.
Then please begin the transfer sequence.
Eun
Message from Izu!@A mobile force led by the gray Thorn has@warped into downtown Taipei!
Into the district with the Lamaris?
Right!
...Could they have come to investigate@the Lamaris, like Debudedabide?
In any case, warp us to the site!@Keep the coordinates as they are!
Squire
Lord Al-Van,@new <Jevilun> have appeared!
...If we take our time,@we'll only wear ourselves out.
Jua-Mu
Lord Al-Van,@I've driven off the Earth forces north of the city.@They won't come near for a while.
Well done, Jua-Mu.
I'd have been happy to kill every last one of them.
Our target this time is the Jevilun alone.@As Her Highness commanded, we will avoid@fighting the Earthlings as much as possible.
(How kind of him.@There's no need to show those people mercy.)
By the way, what about the Jevilun?
Yes, the conditions are...
Lord Al-Van, the Jevilun!
They fused even in front of us. In that case...
This reading is...
Someone seems to be warping in.@The <Zovorg>, perhaps?
If they're using spatial transfer, that's likely.
Then we'll deal with them.
Understood.@I'll observe the Jevilun a while longer.
Captain, spatial transfer complete.@We're in northern Taipei, near Mount Qixing.
Then, once we've checked the surroundings...
Enemy units approaching! Straight from 12 o'clock!
Hmph, so it's the Steel Dragons.@Their ships have gotten cocky enough to warp now?
We'll intercept. All mobile units, launch at once.
What should we do about the Granteed?
It may sortie, but if a <Thorn> appears@in the combat area, it will return to the ship.
(The gray Thorn isn't here?)
(The one leading them is him...@the same model as the one code-named White Horn...)
So you've come out, Granteed...@And that woman too.
Jua-Mu. If it's the Steel Dragons, fall back.
Why? Our top-priority target@is right in front of us.
I said we'd avoid fighting the Earthlings@as much as possible.
But So-Des failed to retake the Granteed@even while using Larseilam.@Isn't this a golden opportunity for us?
If we recover the Throne Unit here,@your standing, Lord Al-Van, would...
Don't underestimate their strength. Fall back.
Either way, we need to hold them off for the@Jevilun investigation, don't we? I'm engaging.
Wait, Jua-Mu.
That's all. Over and out!
...Is this all right, Lord Jua-Mu?
Lord Al-Van said that out of concern for us.@But for the sake of the Fury's long-cherished@wish, we can't let this chance slip away.
Besides, I won't let those Agents lord it over us.@I'll take responsibility. All units, attack!
Eleve 1 to all units!@Destroy the enemy and open a path into Taipei!
(I'm not stopping at that.@My target is that White Horn...@I'll beat it and drag out the gray Thorn!)
(If I earn merit here, then once Dad, Mom,@and Kudo-Ra wake up, I can give them@a good life.)
(No more tragedies like Adu-Mu's...@I'll do it!)
Tch! Don't get cocky, Earthlings!
You left an opening!
What!?
Katia
Calvina?!
C-Calvina?!
Melua
C-Calvina?!
I'll capture this unit!
(This guy...!)
If you value your life, don't resist!
(I keep quiet, and she gets carried away...!)
What's wrong? You understand me, don't you?!
...Yes, I hear you just fine, Instructor.
Wha...? What did you just say...?
Aw, come on. Did you forget?@It's me, Julian.@Your adorable student.
Julian?! THE Julian?!@Impossible, you can't be alive...!
And yet, here I am.
Calvina, you know that guy?!
Calvina, you know him?!
Calvina,@do you know that man...?!
Stay out of this!
Oh my, it concerns that little girl too, doesn't it?@She was there at <Ashurey>, after all.
Then where were you back then?!
You moving up the Bellzelute's test flight@was unexpected. If it had gone as scheduled,@I could've gotten rid of you easily.
Gotten rid of...?!@Don't tell me you were in that Hückebein...!
That's right.
The attack on Ashurey@was a setup...?!
What!?
Whaaat!?
Calvina! What are you doing?!
Get away from him!
C'mon, move it!
After all, you were just@a hired test pilot.
Then Ally and Seldoa...@What was <Ashurey Kreuzer> doing?!
You don't need to know the truth.@Oh, but I'll tell you this much.
My real name isn't Julian.@It's Jua-Mu... Jua-Mu Dalubi.
Jua...?!@Wh-Who are you... Who are you people...?!
I told you, you don't need to know.@Die here, along with that fake!
Ngh... Rgh...!
Guh!@The Volrent's being beaten this badly?!
Withdraw, Jua-Mu.
L-Lord Al-Van...!
Our investigation will be finished soon.@You've fulfilled your role well enough.@Fall back.
B-But, sir!
We cannot afford to suffer further losses.@That is an order. Withdraw, Jua-Mu Dalubi.
...Y-Yes, sir.
(Julian... Jua-Mu...@Was he an enemy from the very start...?)
(Then what about him... What about Ally...)
You seemed to be talking@with the enemy pilot.@What was that about?
Th-That's...
Dragon 2 to all units.@Advance into downtown Taipei at once.
All units, you heard her. Anyone needing@resupply or field repairs, report in. The rest,@regroup into formation by team.
...Calvina, after the operation,@you're gonna tell us what that was about.
(The gray Thorn I fought in Izu back then@seemed to know my maneuvers.@Could it be...!)
(Calvina...)
(Calvina...)
(Could this... have something to do with us too?)
I don't care what you're doing here!@I'll take down you and the gray Thorn!
(You'd be surprised if you knew who I really am.)
J-Julian... What on earth are you...?!
Calvina, pull yourself together!
Calvina, get a grip!
Pull yourself together, Calvina!
Maybe you'd be happier dying@without knowing the truth, Instructor!
Are you after the Granteed?!@Or is it the Lamaris?!
(If anything, I'm after you, Earthling!)
What were you talking about with Calvina?!@What did you say to her?!
(It concerns you too, boy!)
